INSERT INTO public.iam_org_type_template (template_version, type_code, name, sort_order, status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES

INSERT INTO public.iam_org_type_template_relation (template_version, parent_type_code, child_type_code, created_by, updated_by) VALUES
(#{templateVersion}, #{item.parentTypeCode}, #{item.childTypeCode}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT template_version, type_code, name, sort_order FROM public.iam_org_type_template WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY template_version DESC, sort_order, id

SELECT r.template_version, r.parent_type_code, r.child_type_code FROM public.iam_org_type_template_relation r WHERE r.is_deleted = false AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.iam_org_type_template t WHERE t.template_version = r.template_version AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND t.is_deleted = false ) ORDER BY r.template_version DESC, r.id
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public.iam_org_type_template WHERE template_version = #{templateVersion} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' AND is_deleted = false
